meta.title: Notenn
meta.description: Diatonic accordion tabs: import a tune and Notenn writes the buttons, bellows and basses.

home.title: Buttons and bellows, note after note.
home.lead: Notenn turns a score or a MIDI file into a diatonic accordion tab: which button to play, which way the bellows go, and the basses, no sheet music reading needed.
home.heroCaption: “Au clair de la lune” on a G/C box: blue is push, red is draw.
home.step1: A MIDI, MusicXML or ABC file, or a tune from your library. Notenn finds the melody by itself.
home.step2: Each note becomes a button number, on the push or draw line, with the bass that goes under it.
home.step3: Listen with the cursor, slow it down, loop a passage, then download the PDF.
home.freeText: The editor runs right in your browser, no account needed: your files stay on your computer unless you save them to your library. Notenn lives on donations from the people who use it.
home.libraryText: With a free account, keep tunes from the bank and your own files, with the fingerings you chose and your settings, on all your devices.

support.title: Support Notenn
support.lead: Notenn is free and ad-free. It runs on donations.
support.costs: Donations pay for the server, the domain name and the time spent adding keyboards, tunes and new instruments.
support.liberapay: Liberapay is a non-profit platform for recurring or one-off donations, taking no commission.
support.other: Tell people about Notenn, report a fingering mistake or suggest a copyright-free tune: every bit of feedback improves the tabs for everyone.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Notenn sets no advertising cookie. Without an account nothing is kept; with one, only what your library needs.
privacy.files: Without an account, an imported piece is read and converted in your browser and never sent to the server. If you save it to your library, it is kept on the server, visible to you only, never published.
privacy.storage: An account keeps your e-mail address, your hashed password, your library (added tunes, files, fingerings) and your settings. A single technical cookie keeps you logged in. E-mails (confirmation, password) are sent through Resend.
privacy.stats: Notenn counts visits with Umami, hosted on its own server: no cookie, no tracking from one visit to the next, no data sold. Only overall figures are kept (pages viewed, country, device type).
privacy.hosting: The site is hosted by OVH, on a server rented by the publisher.
privacy.rights: You can delete your account at any time from the My account page: everything in it is erased at once. For any question, write to the address given in the legal notice.
